title: Powering the AI data boom with recycled EV batteries
excerpt: Colin Campbell, CTO of Redwood Materials, tells BI's Alistair Barr how the company is scaling up its energy storage business.
content_html:
2026-11-19T22:18:36.188Z

Description

When Colin Campbell joined Redwood Materials as CTO, the company was focused on extracting valuable metals and minerals from old EV batteries.

But now the company is expanding, using those same batteries to store energy for data centers and other facilities. Campbell thinks this business could be even bigger than Redwood's original operation.

He tells Business Insider's Alistair Barr how the idea came about and how the company is scaling it up. He also offers advice for attracting investors.
